config.Highlight Texts For More Info!.de: = Have A Fantastic Day & Happy Fishing! =
config.Disable Yearly Developer Gifts.de: This setting will disable the mod developer gifts you will receive yearly. By default, you will receive a yearly randomized gift from myself :-)
config.Fishing Difficulty.name: Fishing Difficulty
config.Fishing Difficulty.description: Select a difficulty setting for the fishing minigame. Easy Settings: Decrease difficulty by 5% to 100%, and include a Super Easy Fishing option. Please note; The Super Easy; Max Fish Bar & Buff option will also increase the fishing level with a buff, this will also increase the chances certain fish can spawn. This enhancement will be particularly beneficial for players aiming to collect fishing treasure chests and grant full fishing xp. Easy Sunday Fishing: Decrease difficulty by 10% to 50% on Sundays only. Hard Settings: Increase difficulty by 5% to 100% with a NIGHTMARE option for those seeking the ultimate challenge! Scroll down for additional options.
config.Fishing Difficulty.values.Super E: Super Easy; Max Fish Bar & Buff
config.Randomized Difficulty.name: Randomized Difficulty
config.Randomized Difficulty.description: When the Fishing Difficulty setting is active, the difficulty of catching fish will vary within the chosen range. For example, setting the difficulty to 25% Easier means each day, fish will be between 0% and 25% easier to catch. One day, they might be 17% easier, and the next day, 23% easier. This setting is compatible with the Easy, Easy Sunday, and Hard Fishing Difficulty options. However, it does NOT work with the Super Easy and NIGHTMARE options!
config.All Times Of Day.name: All Times Of Day
config.All Times Of Day.description: All fish are now catchable at any time of day.
config.All Types Of Weather.name: All Types Of Weather
config.All Types Of Weather.description: All fish, except legendary fish, can now be caught in all types of weather.
config.All Seasons.name: All Seasons
config.All Seasons.description: All fish, except legendary fish, can now be caught in every season.
config.Same Spawn Rates.name: Same Spawn Rates
config.Same Spawn Rates.description: All fish, except legendary fish, now share the same spawn rates.
config.Cave/Mine Fish Availability.name: Cave/Mine Fish Availability
config.Cave/Mine Fish Availability.descr: The rare cave and mine fish; Stonefish, Ice Pip, and Lava Eel are now available in specific locations. Must be Fishing Level 5. Stonefish; Mountain, Ice Pip; Forest Lake, Lava Eel; Desert. Choose a spawn rate for the fish. Ranges from 1% to 50% chance. Scroll down to see more options.
config.Night Market Fish Availability.de: The Night Market Fish (Midnight Squid, Spook Fish, and Blobfish) will now be fishable anywhere on the Beach during Winter after 5pm. Must be Fishing level 5. The All Times Of Day and All Seasons settings will also have an effect on these fish.
config.Fishable Prize Tickets.name: Fishable Prize Tickets
config.Fishable Prize Tickets.descriptio: Prize Tickets are now a fishable item. Similar to Seaweed and Algae (No minigame). Select a spawn rate ranging from a 1% to 50% chance. Scroll down for additional options.
config.Clean Waters/No Trash.name: Clean Waters/No Trash
config.Clean Waters/No Trash.description: Select a setting to remove or replace all trash items while fishing. No Trash: Disables trash while fishing entirely. Crab Pot Fish: Replaces trash items with crab pot fish during fishing. Note that occasional trash items may still be fished up. Trash serves as a fallback if no fish spawn, but these settings significantly reduce trash chances.
config.Clean Waters/No Weeds.name: Clean Waters/No Weeds
config.Clean Waters/No Weeds.description: Select a setting to remove or replace Seaweed, Green Algae, and White Algae while fishing. No Weeds and Algae: Disables all weeds and algae while fishing entirely. Crab Pot Fish: Replaces seaweed and algae with any crab pot fish during fishing.
config.Iridium Rod Attach. Slots.name: Iridium Rod Attach. Slots
config.Iridium Rod Attach. Slots.descrip: Select how many attachment slots are available on the Iridium Rod. Default is 1. This will allow you to stack bobber and lure effects. Please note, this will only apply to newly acquired Iridium Rods after the setting is enabled, you may have to repurchase a rod! Ranges from 2 to 10 extra slots, each selection also accounts for there being 1 bait slot. Please note, this will only apply to newly acquired Iridium Rods after the setting is enabled! Also note, adding extra slots may cause the slot graphics to go outside the info box. This will not have any effect on the game. Scroll down to see additional options.
config.Adv. Iridium Rod Attach. Slots.de: Select how many attachment slots are available on the Advanced Iridium Rod. Default is 3. This will allow you to stack bobber and lure effects. Ranges from 3 to 10 extra attachment slots, each selection also accounts for there being 1 bait slot. Please note, this will only apply to newly acquired Advanced Iridium Rods after the setting is enabled! Also note, adding extra slots may cause the slot graphics to go outside the info box. This will not have any effect on the game. Scroll down to see additional options.
config.Crab Pots Same Spawn Rates.name: Crab Pots Same Spawn Rates
config.Crab Pots Same Spawn Rates.descri: Crab Pot fish will now all share the same spawn rates. Does not apply to the Jellies and Bug Meat settings below!
config.Crab Pots No Trash.name: Crab Pots No Trash
config.Crab Pots No Trash.description: Crab Pots will no longer yield trash items.
config.Crab Pots Jellies.name: Crab Pots Jellies
config.Crab Pots Jellies.description: Crab Pots now spawn Jellies. This includes River, Sea, and Cave Jellies. If using the Lookup Anything and/or Stardew Progress mods, this will also remove the jellies from the fish collections tab. This is due to a bug in game but this will not have any negative impacts on existing playthroughs if completing the fish collection! It will simply remove the jellies entries and the collection will still be completable!
config.Crab Pots Bug Meat.name: Crab Pots Bug Meat
config.Crab Pots Bug Meat.description: Crab Pots now spawn Bug Meat. Choose whether they can spawn in freshwater (rivers and lakes) or the ocean (beach).
config.Jelly Spawn Rates.name: Jelly Spawn Rates
config.Jelly Spawn Rates.description: Select a setting to determine the spawn rates of all jellies while fishing. Ranges from a 1% to 50% chance or remove jellies altogether. The Default 10% chance has them in the same pool as normal fish so they're more rare than stated. Selecting 10% in the options will be a 'true' 10% chance to spawn jellies instead of using the default method. All other spawn settings will also put the jellies in their own spawn pool. Using this setting also removes the luck chance boost. Scroll down for additional options.
config.Cave Jelly Desert.name: Cave Jelly Desert
config.Cave Jelly Desert.description: Cave Jelly will now spawn in the Desert fishing area. Replaces the River Jelly that would normally spawn in that location.
config.Jellies Are Crab Pot Fish.name: Jellies Are Crab Pot Fish
config.Jellies Are Crab Pot Fish.descrip: All jellies will now be any crab pot fish when fished up. This has no effect on the Cave Jelly Desert setting.
config.Fish Sell Value.name: Fish Sell Value
config.Fish Sell Value.description: Select the sell value of all fish (except legendary fish). The range is from 10% to 1000% increase or a 10% to 99% decrease. Refer to the Legendary Fish Sell Values setting below to do the same for legendary fish. Note that enabling or disabling these settings affects newly acquired fish after your chosen setting is enabled. Scroll down for additional options.
config.Legendary Fish Sell Value.name: Legendary Fish Sell Value
config.Legendary Fish Sell Value.descrip: Select the sell value of legendary fish. The range is from 10% to 1000% increase and a 10% to 99% decrease. Note that enabling or disabling these settings affects newly acquired legendary fish after your chosen setting is enabled. Scroll down for additional options.
config.Seasonal Fish On Farm.name: Seasonal Fish On Farm
config.Seasonal Fish On Farm.description: Seasonal Fish are now catchable on the farm, across all farm maps.
config.Specialty Fish On Farm.name: Specialty Fish On Farm
config.Specialty Fish On Farm.descriptio: Specialty Fish are now catchable on the farm, across all farm maps.
config.Legendary Fish On Farm.name: Legendary Fish On Farm
config.Legendary Fish On Farm.descriptio: Legendary Fish are now catchable on the farm, across all farm maps. Only one legendary fish can be caught on a farm map unless you enable the 'Recatch Legendary Fish' option which will allow you to catch more than one.
config.Recatch Legendary Fish.name: Recatch Legendary Fish
config.Recatch Legendary Fish.descriptio: Legendary fish can now be caught multiple times.
config.Legendary Quests (Recatch REQ).de: Unlock new quests related to legendary fish! Keep in mind that the ‘Recatch Legendary Fish’ setting must be enabled for this feature to function. Once you’ve successfully caught a legendary fish and are in the appropriate season, these new quests will become available.
config.Entire Area Legendary Fish.name: Entire Area Legendary Fish
config.Entire Area Legendary Fish.descri: Legendary fish are no longer restricted to specific points on the map; they can now be caught anywhere within their residing area. For instance, the Crimsonfish can be found all around the beach, not solely at the eastern docks.
config.Legendary Fish Spawn Rates.name: Legendary Fish Spawn Rates
config.Legendary Fish Spawn Rates.descri: Select the chance of legendary fish spawning while fishing. Ranges from 1% to 50% chance. Scroll down for additional options.
config.Legendary Fish No Level.name: Legendary Fish No Level
config.Legendary Fish No Level.descripti: Removes the fishing requirements in order for legendary fish to spawn.
config.Legendary Fish No Crown.name: Legendary Fish No Crown
config.Legendary Fish No Crown.descripti: Legendary fish will no longer have the crown (Boss Fish) icon during the minigame. This will also lower the xp to a standard fish rate.
config.Qi's Legendary Fish Crown.name: Qi's Legendary Fish Crown
config.Qi's Legendary Fish Crown.descrip: The legendary fish that appear during Qi’s Special Order Request will now be distinguished by the crown (Boss Fish) icon in the fishing minigame. This will also increase the xp to a legendary fish rate.
config.All Weather Legendary Fish.name: All Weather Legendary Fish
config.All Weather Legendary Fish.descri: Legendary fish can now be caught in all types of weather.
config.All Seasons Legendary Fish.name: All Seasons Legendary Fish
config.All Seasons Legendary Fish.descri: Legendary fish can now be caught in every season.
config.Remove Shinidamachu Day Req..name: Remove Shinidamachu Day Req.
config.Remove Shinidamachu Day Req..desc: MORE NEW FISH (MNF) ONLY! Remove the Legendary Fish, Shinidamachu's day requirement to spawn. This option will only work if you have the More New Fish (MNF) mod installed!
config.Lucky Legendary Fish.name: Lucky Legendary Fish
config.Lucky Legendary Fish.description: Legendary fish now only spawn when daily luck from the TV is at its highest.
config.Curious Legendary Fish.name: Curious Legendary Fish
config.Curious Legendary Fish.descriptio: Select the effectiveness of the Curiosity Lure buff for Legendary Fish. This range spans from 10% to 100%. Scroll down for additional options.
config.Legendary Fish Gifts.name: Legendary Fish Gifts
config.Legendary Fish Gifts.description: Legendary fish are now a universally loved gift for all the villagers.
config.Legendary Fish 7am To 9am.name: Legendary Fish 7am To 9am
config.Legendary Fish 7am To 9am.descrip: Legendary fish are now exclusively accessible from 7AM to 9AM, and this time frame can be combined with the other time settings.
config.Legendary Fish 12pm To 2pm.name: Legendary Fish 12pm To 2pm
config.Legendary Fish 12pm To 2pm.descri: Legendary fish are now exclusively accessible from 12PM to 2PM, and this time frame can be combined with the other time settings.
config.Legendary Fish 11pm To 1am.name: Legendary Fish 11pm To 1am
config.Legendary Fish 11pm To 1am.descri: Legendary fish are now exclusively accessible from 11PM to 1AM, and this time frame can be combined with the other time settings.
config.Fishable Prismatic Shards (REQ).d: Prismatic Shards are now available for fishing and can be caught in most locations upon reaching Fishing Level 5. Prismatic Shards can also be placed inside fish tanks with this setting enabled! This setting is essential for configuring most of the Prismatic Shard settings below!
config.Prismatic Shard Spawn Rate.name: Prismatic Shard Spawn Rate
config.Prismatic Shard Spawn Rate.descri: Select the spawn rate of fishable Prismatic Shards. Ranges from a 1% to 50% chance. Please note that the Fishable Prismatic Shards (REQ) setting must be enabled for this to take effect! Scroll down for additional options.
config.Prismatic Shards No Level.name: Prismatic Shards No Level
config.Prismatic Shards No Level.descrip: Removes the fishing level 5 requirement in order for Prismatic Shards to spawn. Please note that the Fishable Prismatic Shards (REQ) setting must be enabled for this to take effect!
config.Prismatic Shards No Crown.name: Prismatic Shards No Crown
config.Prismatic Shards No Crown.descrip: Prismatic Shards will no longer have the legendary fish (crown) icon during the fishing minigame. This will allow lower the amount of fishing xp earned when catching a shard. Please note that the Fishable Prismatic Shards (REQ) setting must be enabled for this to take effect!
config.Lucky Prismatic Shards.name: Lucky Prismatic Shards
config.Lucky Prismatic Shards.descriptio: Prismatic Shards will now only spawn when daily luck is at its highest (purple star on the TV). Please note that the Fishable Prismatic Shards (REQ) setting must be enabled for this to take effect!
config.Prismatic Shards Weather.name: Prismatic Shards Weather
config.Prismatic Shards Weather.descript: Prismatic Shards are now exclusive to rainy and snowy weather for catching. Please note that the Fishable Prismatic Shards (REQ) setting must be enabled for this to take effect!
config.Prismatic Shards 7am To 9am.name: Prismatic Shards 7am To 9am
config.Prismatic Shards 7am To 9am.descr: Prismatic Shards are now exclusive to the hours between 7AM and 9AM for catching, and this time frame can be combined with the other time settings. Please note that the Fishable Prismatic Shards (REQ) setting must be enabled for this to take effect!
config.Prismatic Shards 12pm To 2pm.name: Prismatic Shards 12pm To 2pm
config.Prismatic Shards 12pm To 2pm.desc: Prismatic Shards are now exclusive to the hours between 12PM and 2PM for catching, and this time frame can be combined with the other time settings. Please note that the Fishable Prismatic Shards (REQ) setting must be enabled for this to take effect!
config.Prismatic Shards 11pm To 1am.name: Prismatic Shards 11pm To 1am
config.Prismatic Shards 11pm To 1am.desc: Prismatic Shards are now exclusive to the hours between 11PM and 1AM for catching, and this time frame can be combined with the other time settings. Please note that the Fishable Prismatic Shards (REQ) setting must be enabled for this to take effect!
config.Prismatic Shard Sell Value.name: Prismatic Shard Sell Value
config.Prismatic Shard Sell Value.descri: Select the sell value of Prismatic Shards. The default value is 2000g, but you can adjust it within a range from 2000g to 1g. This will only apply to newly acquired Prismatic Shards after the setting is enabled! Importantly, this setting operates independently and does not rely on any other Prismatic Shard configurations! Scroll down for additional options.
config.Fish Pond Rare Loot.name: Fish Pond Rare Loot
config.Fish Pond Rare Loot.description: Select the likelihood of rare loot spawning from fish pond buildings. Options range from 1.5X to 5X increase. Alternatively, the All Rare Loot 1 to 50% Chance option ensures an equal chance for all rare loot from fish ponds to appear. Scroll down for additional options.
config.FP Fish/Quest Spawn Time.name: FP Fish/Quest Spawn Time
config.FP Fish/Quest Spawn Time.descript: Select the speed for fish reproduction and when new fish pond quests appear from fish pond buildings. These options will take effect only when the fish pond is empty, and you’ve enabled the desired setting before adding fish.
config.Fish Pond Legendary Fish (REQ).de: Legendary fish will now have a variety of loot from fish pond buildings rather than just being roe. This setting is required for the legendary fish pond settings below!
config.Legendary Fish Pond Loot.name: Legendary Fish Pond Loot
config.Legendary Fish Pond Loot.descript: Select the likelihood of legendary fish rare loot spawning from fish pond buildings. The available settings range from 2X to 5X increase. The Rare Loot Chance All 50% option ensures that all rare loot from fish ponds has an equal chance to spawn. The Less Rare More Roe option decreases the chances for rare loot but increases the chances for Roe. Note: This feature requires the Fish Pond Legendary Fish (REQ) setting to be enabled!
config.LG Fish/Quest Spawn Time.name: LG Fish/Quest Spawn Time
config.LG Fish/Quest Spawn Time.descript: Select the speed for legendary fish reproduction and when new legendary fish pond quests appear from fish pond buildings. This feature requires the Fish Pond Legendary Fish (REQ) setting to be enabled! These options will take effect only when the fish pond is empty, and you’ve enabled the desired setting before adding fish.
config.Fish Pond Prismatic Shards.name: Fish Pond Prismatic Shards
config.Fish Pond Prismatic Shards.descri: Every fish pond building now has the opportunity to yield Prismatic Shards when the fish ponds are at full capacity.
config.Tackle Materials.name: Tackle Materials
config.Tackle Materials.description: Reduce the material requirements for crafting tackle and lures.
config.Tackle Fishing Level 1.name: Tackle Fishing Level 1
config.Tackle Fishing Level 1.descriptio: All tackle can now be learned at Fishing Level 1.
config.Craftable Curiosity Lure.name: Craftable Curiosity Lure
config.Craftable Curiosity Lure.descript: The Curiosity Lure can now be crafted, and the recipe will be learned either at Fishing Level 9 or Level 1. This lure enhances the likelihood of rare fish spawning.
config.Curiosity Lure Materials.name: Curiosity Lure Materials
config.Curiosity Lure Materials.descript: Reduce the material requirements for crafting the Curiosity Lure. Note that this feature requires the Craftable Curiosity Lure setting to be enabled!
config.Craftable Lead Bobber.name: Craftable Lead Bobber
config.Craftable Lead Bobber.description: The Lead Bobber can now be crafted, and the recipe will be learned either at Fishing Level 4 or Level 1. This bobber slows down the bounce of the green fish bar when hitting the bottom.
config.Lead Bobber Materials.name: Lead Bobber Materials
config.Lead Bobber Materials.description: Reduce the material requirements for crafting the Lead Bobber. Note that this feature requires the Craftable Lead Bobber setting to be enabled!
config.Wild Bait Crafting Materials.name: Wild Bait Crafting Materials
config.Wild Bait Crafting Materials.desc: Reduce the material requirements for crafting Wild Bait.
config.Trout Soup Duration.name: Trout Soup Duration
config.Trout Soup Duration.description: The Trout Soup food item buffs will now persist for a full day.
config.Trout Soup Level Boost.name: Trout Soup Level Boost
config.Trout Soup Level Boost.descriptio: Select the fishing level boost provided by the Trout Soup food item. By default, it grants a +1 level boost to fishing, but you can adjust it within a range of +2 to +50. Scroll down for additional options.
config.Trout Soup Ingredients.name: Trout Soup Ingredients
config.Trout Soup Ingredients.descriptio: Select an option to reduce the ingredient requirements for the Trout Soup recipe.
config.Chowder Duration.name: Chowder Duration
config.Chowder Duration.description: The Chowder food item buffs will now persist for a full day.
config.Chowder Level Boost.name: Chowder Level Boost
config.Chowder Level Boost.description: Select the fishing level boost provided by the Chowder food item. By default, it grants a +1 level boost to fishing, but you can adjust it within a range of +2 to +50. Scroll down for additional options.
config.Chowder Ingredients.name: Chowder Ingredients
config.Chowder Ingredients.description: Select an option to reduce the ingredient requirements for the Chowder recipe.
config.Shrimp Cocktail Duration.name: Shrimp Cocktail Duration
config.Shrimp Cocktail Duration.descript: The Shrimp Cocktail food item buffs will now persist for a full day.
config.Shrimp Cocktail Level Boost.name: Shrimp Cocktail Level Boost
config.Shrimp Cocktail Level Boost.descr: Select the fishing level boost provided by the Shrimp Cocktail food item. By default, it grants a +1 level boost to fishing, but you can adjust it within a range of +2 to +50. Scroll down for additional options.
config.Shrimp Cocktail Ingredients.name: Shrimp Cocktail Ingredients
config.Shrimp Cocktail Ingredients.descr: Select an option to reduce the ingredient requirements for the Shrimp Cocktail recipe.
config.Fish Taco Duration.name: Fish Taco Duration
config.Fish Taco Duration.description: The Fish Taco food item buffs will now persist for a full day.
config.Fish Taco Level Boost.name: Fish Taco Level Boost
config.Fish Taco Level Boost.description: Select the fishing level boost provided by the Fish Taco food item. By default, it grants a +2 level boost to fishing, but you can adjust it within a range of +3 to +50. Scroll down for additional options.
config.Fish Taco Ingredients.name: Fish Taco Ingredients
config.Fish Taco Ingredients.description: Select an option to reduce the ingredient requirements for the Fish Taco recipe.
config.Escargot Duration.name: Escargot Duration
config.Escargot Duration.description: The Escargot food item buffs will now persist for a full day.
config.Escargot Level Boost.name: Escargot Level Boost
config.Escargot Level Boost.description: Select the fishing level boost provided by the Escargot food item. By default, it grants a +2 level boost to fishing, but you can adjust it within a range of +3 to +50. Scroll down for additional options.
config.Escargot Ingredients.name: Escargot Ingredients
config.Escargot Ingredients.description: Select an option to reduce the ingredient requirements for the Escargot recipe.
config.Dish O' The Sea Duration.name: Dish O' The Sea Duration
config.Dish O' The Sea Duration.descript: The Dish O' The Sea food item buffs will now persist for a full day.
config.Dish O' The Sea Level Boost.name: Dish O' The Sea Level Boost
config.Dish O' The Sea Level Boost.descr: Select the fishing level boost provided by the Dish O' The Sea food item. By default, it grants a +3 level boost to fishing, but you can adjust it within a range of +4 to +50. Scroll down for additional options.
config.Dish O' The Sea Fishing Level 1.n: Dish O' The Sea Fishing Level 1
config.Dish O' The Sea Fishing Level 1.d: The Dish O' The Sea recipe is now accessible at Fishing Level 1, rather than Level 3.
config.Dish O' The Sea Ingredients.name: Dish O' The Sea Ingredients
config.Dish O' The Sea Ingredients.descr: Select an option to reduce the ingredient requirements for the Dish O' The Sea recipe.
config.Fish Stew Duration.name: Fish Stew Duration
config.Fish Stew Duration.description: The Fish Stew food item buffs will now persist for a full day.
config.Fish Stew Level Boost.name: Fish Stew Level Boost
config.Fish Stew Level Boost.description: Select the fishing level boost provided by the Fish Stew food item. By default, it grants a +3 level boost to fishing, but you can adjust it within a range of +4 to +50. Scroll down for additional options.
config.Fish Stew Ingredients.name: Fish Stew Ingredients
config.Fish Stew Ingredients.description: Select an option to reduce the ingredient requirements for the Fish Stew recipe.
config.Lobster Bisque Duration.name: Lobster Bisque Duration
config.Lobster Bisque Duration.descripti: The Lobster Bisque food item buffs will now persist for a full day.
config.Lobster Bisque Level Boost.name: Lobster Bisque Level Boost
config.Lobster Bisque Level Boost.descri: Select the fishing level boost provided by the Lobster Bisque food item. By default, it grants a +3 level boost to fishing, but you can adjust it within a range of +4 to +50. Scroll down for additional options.
config.Lobster Bisque Ingredients.name: Lobster Bisque Ingredients
config.Lobster Bisque Ingredients.descri: Select an option to reduce the ingredient requirements for the Lobster Bisque recipe.
config.Seafoam Pudding Duration.name: Seafoam Pudding Duration
config.Seafoam Pudding Duration.descript: The Seafoam Pudding food item buffs will now persist for a full day.
config.Seafoam Pudding Level Boost.name: Seafoam Pudding Level Boost
config.Seafoam Pudding Level Boost.descr: Select the fishing level boost provided by the Seafoam Pudding food item. By default, it grants a +4 level boost to fishing, but you can adjust it within a range of +5 to +50. Scroll down for additional options.
config.Seafoam Pudding Fishing Level 1.d: The Seafoam Pudding recipe is now accessible at Fishing Level 1, rather than Level 9.
config.Seafoam Pudding Ingredients.name: Seafoam Pudding Ingredients
config.Seafoam Pudding Ingredients.descr: Reduce the ingredient requirements for the Seafoam Pudding recipe, allowing for a range of 1 to 25 of any fish.
config.Worm Bin Materials.name: Worm Bin Materials
config.Worm Bin Materials.description: Reduce the material requirements for crafting Worm Bins.
config.Worm Bin Level Availability.name: Worm Bin Level Availability
config.Worm Bin Level Availability.descr: Select the fishing level at which you can learn the Worm Bin crafting recipe.
config.Worm Bin Bait Min Amount.name: Worm Bin Bait Min Amount
config.Worm Bin Bait Min Amount.descript: Select the minimum daily bait production from Worm Bins, with options ranging from 2 to 100. Scroll down for additional options.
config.Worm Bin Bait Max Amount.name: Worm Bin Bait Max Amount
config.Worm Bin Bait Max Amount.descript: Select the maximum daily bait production from Worm Bins, with options ranging from 6 to 100. Scroll down for additional options.
config.Worm Bin Wild Bait (REQ).name: Worm Bin Wild Bait (REQ)
config.Worm Bin Wild Bait (REQ).descript: Worm Bins now possess a slight chance of producing Wild Bait. This feature is essential for configuring the Wild Bait settings below!
config.Worm Bin Wild Bait Chance.name: Worm Bin Wild Bait Chance
config.Worm Bin Wild Bait Chance.descrip: Select the probability of daily Wild Bait production from Worm Bins. The available range spans from 15% to 100% chance. Note that this feature requires the Worm Bin Chance For Wild Bait (REQ) setting to be enabled! Scroll down for additional options.
config.Worm Bin Wild Bait Min Amount.nam: Worm Bin Wild Bait Min Amount
config.Worm Bin Wild Bait Min Amount.des: Select the minimum daily production of Wild Bait from Worm Bins, with a range spanning from 2 to 100. Note that this feature requires the Worm Bin Chance For Wild Bait (REQ) setting to be enabled! Scroll down for additional options.
config.Worm Bin Wild Bait Max Amount.nam: Worm Bin Wild Bait Max Amount
config.Worm Bin Wild Bait Max Amount.des: Select the maximum daily production of Wild Bait from Worm Bins, with a range spanning from 6 to 100. Note that this feature requires the Worm Bin Chance For Wild Bait (REQ) setting to be enabled! Scroll down for additional options.
config.Deluxe Worm Bin Materials.name: Deluxe Worm Bin Materials
config.Deluxe Worm Bin Materials.descrip: Reduce the material requirements for crafting Deluxe Worm Bins.
Select the fishing level at which you can learn the Deluxe Worm Bin crafting recipe.
config.Deluxe Worm Bin Bait Min.name: Deluxe Worm Bin Bait Min
config.Deluxe Worm Bin Bait Min.descript: Select the minimum daily bait production from Deluxe Worm Bins, with options ranging from 2 to 100. Scroll down for additional options.
config.Deluxe Worm Bin Bait Max.name: Deluxe Worm Bin Bait Max
config.Deluxe Worm Bin Bait Max.descript: Select the maximum daily bait production from Deluxe Worm Bins, with options ranging from 6 to 100. Scroll down for additional options.
config.Deluxe Worm Bin Wild Bait (REQ).d: Deluxe Worm Bins now possess a slight chance of producing Wild Bait. This feature is essential for configuring the Wild Bait settings below!
config.Deluxe Worm Bin Wild B. Chance.na: Deluxe Worm Bin Wild B. Chance
config.Deluxe Worm Bin Wild B. Chance.de: Select the probability of daily Wild Bait production from Deluxe Worm Bins. The available range spans from 15% to 100% chance. Note that this feature requires the Deluxe Worm Bin Chance For Wild Bait (REQ) setting to be enabled! Scroll down for additional options.
config.Deluxe Worm Bin Wild Bait Min.nam: Deluxe Worm Bin Wild Bait Min
config.Deluxe Worm Bin Wild Bait Min.des: Select the minimum daily production of Wild Bait from Deluxe Worm Bins, with a range spanning from 2 to 100. Note that this feature requires the Deluxe Worm Bin Chance For Wild Bait (REQ) setting to be enabled! Scroll down for additional options.
config.Deluxe Worm Bin Wild Bait Max.nam: Deluxe Worm Bin Wild Bait Max
config.Deluxe Worm Bin Wild Bait Max.des: Select the maximum daily production of Wild Bait from Deluxe Worm Bins, with a range spanning from 6 to 100. Note that this feature requires the Deluxe Worm Bin Chance For Wild Bait (REQ) setting to be enabled! Scroll down for additional options.
config.Recycling Machine Faster.name: Recycling Machine Faster
config.Recycling Machine Faster.descript: Reduce the production time for Recycling Machines, with options ranging from 50 minutes to 10 minutes. Scroll down for additional options.
config.Recycling Machine Materials.name: Recycling Machine Materials
config.Recycling Machine Materials.descr: Reduce the material requirements for crafting Recycling Machines.
config.Recycling Machine Level Avail..de: Select the fishing level at which you can acquire the Recycling Machine crafting recipe.
config.Recycling Machine Produce Min.des: Select the minimum daily production of materials from Recycling Machines, all items produced by default have different ranges. Picking an option, will make all trash items produce the same number of materials. Scroll down for additional options.
config.Recycling Machine Produce Max.des: Select the maximum daily production of materials from Recycling Machines, all items produced by default have different ranges. Picking an option, will make all trash items produce the same number of materials. Scroll down for additional options.
Select the amount of items required to be placed inside Recycling Machines. Default is 1. Scroll down for additional options.
config.Recycling Machine Tackle.name: Recycling Machine Tackle
